definitions: To make a strenuous or unusually great effort.
To injure a part of one's body by overexertion.
To pour a liquid through a sieve or other straining device to separate solids.
To stretch, pull, or push something with force.
To put a severe demand on the strength, resources, or abilities of someone or something.
examples: He had to strain to hear the faint music.
She strained a muscle in her leg while running.
Strain the pasta before adding the sauce.
The rope began to strain under the weight.
The constant pressure began to strain their relationship.
